name: DFW 2001 to 2011 single-story, 2000 IECC
description: Single-story slab house permitted September 2001 to 2011 under the 2000 IECC, the first Texas energy code: R-30 attic, R-13 walls, windows at or under U 0.65 and SHGC 0.40, no blower-door or duct test. Inspect and override.

era.code_basis: 2000 IECC with 2001 Supplement statewide, September 2001 to December 2011 (SECO; Senate Bill 5).

sources.citation: RhoeFlow DFW era template research (claude/01-plan/dfw-era-template-research.md), section Era by era: 2001 to 2011. Every value, its range, evidence type and confidence.
Texas SECO, single-family energy code history: no statewide code before September 2001; 2000 IECC 2001-2011; 2009 IRC from 2012; 2015 IRC from September 2016
Chan and Sherman, LBNL-5552E: new US homes median NL 0.29 (about 5.6 ACH50 one story), Texas a large share
Stone, DeVito and Nease, ESL-HH-02-05-16 (2002), Table 1: 2000 IECC/IRC values for about 2,400 HDD (Dallas): U 0.65, SHGC 0.40, ceiling R-30, wall R-13, slab R-0
NCTCOG/ESL regional amendments to the 2000 IECC (Feb 2002): detached homes with under 15% glazing U 0.65, ceiling R-30, wall R-13; no blower-door or duct test
TDLR technical bulletin: SHGC may not exceed 0.40 at 3,500 HDD or fewer, covering most of Texas
Chasar et al. 2002, Building America homes near Dallas monitored 1999-2000: frame homes 5.0 and 5.1 ACH50; duct leakage to outside 10.8 and 13.5 cfm25 per 100 ft2
RhoeFlow plan v2, Era-based defaults for DFW table (claude/01-plan/research-and-plan.md); estimates to seed the questionnaire

ceiling_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Code: 2000 IECC R-30 for DFW (about 2,400 heating degree days).

window_ufactor.basis: Code maximum U 0.65. Meeting the SHGC 0.40 limit takes low-E glass, which usually brings U well under this, so read the NFRC label and override.

window_shgc.basis: Code maximum SHGC 0.40 for Texas at 3,500 heating degree days or fewer.

air_leakage.basis: No code limit applied. Dallas research homes measured 5.0 and 5.1 (Chasar 2002) and new US homes about 5.6 (ResDB); picked above them because these were not typical builds. A blower-door result replaces this.

duct_insulation_r.basis: R-6 flex in the attic (plan table); the 2000 IECC duct table was not opened, low confidence. Read the jacket label.

duct_leakage_to_outside.basis: Measured 10.8 and 13.5 cfm25 per 100 ft2 to outside in Dallas homes of the time (Chasar 2002); no code test. A duct-blaster result replaces this.
